purpose: Prepare fact-candidate extraction, approval, mint, and semantic state tracking for the default production path.

candidate_extraction.goal: Extract candidate facts from final chapter outputs
candidate_extraction.acceptance: Every candidate fact can be traced back to explicit textual evidence

batch_approval.goal: Classify candidate facts into actionable queues
batch_approval.acceptance: Each approved fact has a written approval record

mint_recompute.goal: Commit approved facts through a single Mint entry point and recompute projections
mint_recompute.acceptance: Next chapter consumes the updated state

semantic_ledger.goal: Maintain knowledge, ability, injury, item, relation expectation, and promise ledgers

next_actions: wire candidate extraction to final chapter output
create approval queue and approval records
route approved facts through the Mint entry point
write semantic ledgers and state diffs
